stories.headline: Cognition Raises $2B at $48B Valuation as Devin Revenue Nears $900M
stories.key_takeaway: Cognition raised more than $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation just four months after its $26 billion round, on run-rate revenue that grew from $492 million to nearly $900 million, signaling investors believe AI coding can support multiple winners.

pull_quote.text: We've never thought about it as replacing humans. I know it's like a scenario, folks have said these things. It has never been our view.

data_points.label: Series E round size
Post-money valuation, up from $26B in May
Run-rate revenue, up from $492M in May
Projected 2026 cash burn

stories.article_excerpt: Four months ago, Cognition was a $26 billion company. On Tuesday it became a $48 billion one — and the only thing that changed was the revenue line.

stories.headline: Mistral Lands €3B Series D at €21B Valuation in Europe's Largest Tech Round
stories.key_takeaway: Mistral's Samsung-led €3B Series D at a €21B valuation is Europe's largest-ever equity round, funding a full-stack sovereign AI bet built on industrial partners rather than pure venture capital.

pull_quote.text: Who controls intelligence, and who can adapt it to their own needs, matters as much as how powerful it is.

stories.article_excerpt: Three years and change after three researchers walked out of Google DeepMind and Meta to start a company in Paris, Mistral AI has closed Europe's largest tech round.

stories.headline: Accenture and Google Cloud Launch Dedicated Gemini Enterprise Business Group
stories.key_takeaway: Google Cloud and Accenture formed a joint Gemini Enterprise Business Group that will field 1,000 Google-trained forward deployed engineers inside customer offices, Google's largest single bet yet on fixing the enterprise AI deployment bottleneck.

pull_quote.text: Deploying agentic AI is a top priority for enterprises today, and the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group significantly expands the expertise and resources available to help our customers deliver real business value.

data_points.label: Forward deployed engineers Google will train

stories.article_excerpt: Google Cloud has spent 2026 trying to solve a problem that money alone cannot fix: enterprises keep buying its AI and then failing to deploy it.

stories.headline: Forus Raises $150M Series C at $3B to Speed AI-Guided Prescription Fulfillment
stories.key_takeaway: Forus tripled its valuation to $3 billion just four months after its Series B, raising $150 million in an all-insider round led by Bain Capital Ventures to scale AI agents that automate prior authorization and pharmacy routing.

pull_quote.text: Forus is becoming how new medicine reaches people in America. The next era of medicine will run on the AI-powered network Forus is building.

stories.headline: Sapien Raises at $180M Valuation to Show CFOs What Actually Drives Profit
stories.key_takeaway: Sapien raised a round led by Neo's Ali Partovi at a $180M valuation as it repositions from FP&A software into diagnosing which operational decisions actually drive a company's financial results.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike and OpenAI Expand Partnership to Secure the Agentic Era
stories.key_takeaway: CrowdStrike will use its new Falcon Guardian product to monitor and enforce controls on OpenAI's Codex agents at runtime while embedding GPT-5.6 Cyber into the Falcon platform, staking a claim on the emerging AI agent security layer.

pull_quote.text: Status quo security is no longer enough, but AI gives defenders a real opportunity to become fundamentally stronger.

stories.headline: GitHub Copilot Workspace Puts Multiple Specialized Agents on One Codebase
stories.key_takeaway: GitHub Copilot Workspace now runs separate implementation, testing, and documentation agents in parallel on the same repository, coordinated through a shared context window — turning the world's most-used AI coding tool into an orchestrated team.

pull_quote.text: With Agent HQ, Claude can pick up issues, create branches, commit code, and respond to pull requests, working alongside your team like any other collaborator.

stories.article_excerpt: For three years, GitHub Copilot's pitch was singular: one assistant, sitting beside one developer, finishing one line at a time. That premise is now gone.

stories.headline: OpenHands Hits 1.0 With Production Sandboxing and 68% on SWE-bench Verified
stories.key_takeaway: OpenHands 1.0 pairs an MIT-licensed, ground-up SDK rewrite with Docker sandboxing, risk-rated tool confirmation and a ~68% SWE-bench Verified score, closing both the capability and the security gap that kept enterprises on closed coding agents.

pull_quote.text: Software development is changing. But a lot of that change is happening behind closed doors. The software engineering community is increasingly aligning behind OpenHands as the open source standard for doing agentic software development at scale.

stories.article_excerpt: The open-source coding agent that began life as a weekend rebuttal to a proprietary demo shipped its 1.0 release on Tuesday.

stories.key_takeaway: Baidu turned its Chaoneng Xiaodu home assistant into an autonomous agent and shipped four devices built around it, including a camera whose second-generation monitoring agent defines and escalates care tasks on its own.

pull_quote.text: The agent upgrade is not just about adding a few features, but about building a system-level capability that serves the entire household.

stories.headline: Google, Anthropic and OpenAI Unveil Cyber Models With Tiered Access Programs
stories.key_takeaway: Google, Anthropic and OpenAI have all converged on the same governance primitive — near-identical models whose cyber capabilities unlock only after a vetting process — making the access gate, not the weights, the industry's de facto safety control.

pull_quote.text: These are agents operating inside your environment and the controls that matter follow zero trust principles... that enforcement lives in your infrastructure, not in the model.

stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard replaces bespoke lab integration work with a single model-agnostic driver spec, cutting instrument setup from weeks to hours and extending the MCP standards playbook from software into physical laboratory equipment.

pull_quote.text: There are also promising prospects for cooperation in the high-tech sector. The adoption of the Memorandum on Cooperation in Artificial Intelligence and the Action Plan for the Introduction of Green Technologies will be an important step in this regard.
